postBody.Query: CloudAppEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d) | where Application in ('Microsoft SharePoint Online', 'Microsoft OneDrive for Business') | extend rawSite = trim_end('/', tostring(RawEventData.SiteUrl)) | where isnotempty(rawSite) | extend siteUrl = tolower(rawSite) | where hash(siteUrl, 4) == {{shardIndex}} | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, rawSite, Application) by siteUrl | extend path = trim('/', tostring(parse_url(rawSite).Path)) | project siteUrl, name = iff(isempty(path), tostring(parse_url(rawSite).Host), path), workload = iff(Application has 'OneDrive', 'OneDrive', 'SharePoint')
